q: The new filing system was advertised as a complete fix. The inspector disagreed: it still left a host of problems unresolved. Which summary matches the inspector's view?
o: Many problems still needed attention.
The system needed a human presenter.
Only one minor problem was left over.
The problems had all been dealt with.

exp.trans: 新归档系统被宣传为彻底解决方案，但检查员认为它仍留下大量未解决的问题。
exp.structure: 主干it left problems unresolved；a host of修饰复数problems，unresolved说明这些问题仍未解决。
exp.other: filing system归档系统；inspector检查员；unresolved未解决的。
exp.meaning: a host of整体表示大量，反驳complete fix所宣称的彻底解决。
exp.rest: human presenter把数量短语当作主持人；only one与大量相反；all dealt with忽略unresolved。

q: A harbour will host a boat festival. Organizers expect a host of small vessels to arrive. How do the two uses of host differ?
o: Both describe the owner of each vessel.
Both describe a person presenting a show.
First: provide the venue; second: many boats.
First: many venues; second: own the boats.

exp.trans: 港口将举办船艇节，组织者预计大量小船会到来。
exp.structure: 第一句host是及物动词，宾语a boat festival；第二句a host of是修饰small vessels的数量短语。
exp.meaning: 同一个拼写在不同句法位置表达举办与大量，不能统一套用主人义。
exp.rest: owner和presenter都把两处当人物名词；many venues颠倒第一处的动词结构，own the boats也不符合第二处数量义。

q: A factory study examined the effects of night shifts and overtime on assembly errors. Which identifies the sources being examined and the outcome being affected?
o: Sources: errors; outcome: shift schedules.
Sources: shifts and overtime; outcome: errors.
Sources: overtime only; outcome: shift length.
Sources: the study; outcome: staff opinions.

exp.trans: 一项工厂研究考察夜班和加班对装配错误的影响。影响来源是夜班与加班，受影响的结果是装配错误。
exp.structure: 主干A study examined the effects；of后night shifts and overtime是两个并列来源，on后assembly errors是受影响对象。
exp.meaning: of A on B并非任意介词组合：A说明何种因素的影响，B说明影响落在哪个对象上。该句不自行给出影响方向或大小。
exp.rest: errors作为来源颠倒方向；overtime only漏掉并列夜班；study只是考察者，不是句子指定的影响来源，staff opinions也没有出现。

q: An engineer asks how room shape changes echoes. Which phrase names that relationship without reversing the source and the affected outcome?
o: the effect of echoes on room shape
the effect between echoes and shape
the effect on shape caused by echoes
the effect of room shape on echoes

exp.trans: 工程师问房间形状如何改变回声，对应房间形状对回声的影响。
exp.structure: 还原：room shape changes echoes；将变化来源room shape置于of之后，受影响的echoes置于on之后。
exp.meaning: 判断搭配也要核对语义方向，不能因为一组of/on形式正确就忽略谁影响谁。
exp.rest: of echoes on room shape与on shape caused by echoes均把方向反过来；between只说两者之间，未构成题目所需的effect of A on B关系。

target: come down with / come up with
skill: come down with / come up with
q: The lead actor came down with flu on opening night, so an understudy performed the role. What happened to the lead actor?
o: He became ill before the performance.
He invented a new role for the show.
He met the understudy unexpectedly.
He published a review of the play.

exp.trans: 主演首演当晚患上流感，因此由替角出演该角色。
exp.structure: 主句The lead actor came down with flu；so连接患病与替角出演这一后续事件。
exp.other: lead actor主演；opening night首演之夜；understudy替角。
exp.meaning: come down with后接疾病，说明患病；需要用事件后果检验短语整体意思。
exp.rest: invented混入come up with想出；met unexpectedly对应come across偶遇；published对应come out的部分用法，均非came down with。

target: come across / come up with / come down with
skill: come across / come up with / come down with
q: A diary says: "I came across an old friend in the port, came up with a new route, and came down with a fever on the way home." Which sequence does it report?
o: Arranged a meeting; lost a route; recovered.
Met by chance; devised a route; became ill.
Published a story; followed a route; returned.
Missed a friend; rejected a route; got better.

exp.trans: 日记说作者在港口偶遇老朋友，想出新路线，回程中发烧患病。
exp.structure: 三个并列谓语came across、came up with、came down with分别支配friend、route、fever；不能单看come或with。
exp.meaning: 动词短语需要整体与其宾语、事件类型对应，而非只根据一粒介词猜测。
exp.rest: arranged把偶遇说成安排；lost、rejected不是想出路线；recovered、got better与患病方向相反；published也不符合这三个短语。

q: In a toy prediction model, departure delays explained 40% of the variation in arrival times. Which pair can replace explained while preserving that statistical meaning? Complete with either expression: delays ___ 40% of the variation.
o: served / contributed to
accounted / contributed
explained / accounted for
served as / resulted from

exp.trans: 在一个示例预测模型中，出发延误解释了到达时间差异的40%。此处可使用explained或accounted for。
exp.structure: delays为主语，explained为及物谓语，40% of the variation为宾语；accounted for作为整体连接同一比例。
exp.other: departure出发；variation差异/变异；prediction model预测模型。
exp.meaning: 统计解释份额与用途角色不同；explain与account for在这里可相近改写，不意味着所有语境中都可互换，也不单凭这一句证明因果。
exp.rest: served直接接比例不表达解释份额；contributed to只说明有所贡献，不能代替此处报告的精确解释比例；accounted缺for；served as是充当，resulted from则表达结果来自某原因，方向与比例关系不同。

q: An orange line on a bridge marks the level reached by an old flood. The town keeps it there to warn future residents. Complete: "The line ___ a reminder of the flood."
o: explained
contributed to
accounted for
served as

exp.trans: 桥上的橙线标出旧洪水曾达到的高度，镇上保留它以提醒后来的居民；这条线起提醒作用。
exp.structure: The line是主语；served as接名词短语a reminder，说明它充当何种提醒标志。
exp.meaning: serve可以表达发挥作用，但这里需要serve as加角色名词，不能把它笼统替换为所有表示效果的动词。
exp.rest: explained a reminder指解释某个提醒，未表达充当提醒；contributed to a reminder是对提醒有所贡献，不是这条线本身充当提醒；accounted for表示解释或构成，也不自然表达这里的用途角色。

q: A workshop improved output after both staff training and a machine upgrade. The manager says training helped, but has not estimated its share. Which statement preserves the available evidence?
o: Training contributed to the improvement in output.
Training explained 70% of the improvement in output.
Training accounted for the entire improvement in output.
Training served 70% of the improvement in output.

exp.trans: 车间在培训和机器升级后提高了产出。经理只说培训有帮助，没有估算其份额；可说培训对改善有贡献。
exp.structure: Training contributed to the improvement：主语Training，谓语contributed，to后接贡献所指向的结果；不是直接支配比例宾语。
exp.meaning: contribute to可以保留有帮助而未量化的关系；explain或account for后带具体份额须有相应证据，不能凭空补出数字。
exp.rest: explained 70%加入未经估算的比例；accounted for the entire把部分贡献扩大成全部；served 70%既补造比例，也没有构成自然的用途或解释份额句型。

target: serve a purpose / serve to do
skill: serve a purpose / serve to do
q: A station ramp is useful because it makes the platforms accessible. Complete both gaps: "It ___ a useful purpose and ___ make access easier."
o: explains; serves as
serves; serves to
accounts for; contributes
contributes to; explains

exp.trans: 车站坡道有实际用途，使人更容易到达站台：它发挥有用作用，并起到便利通行的作用。
exp.structure: 第一空serve直接接a useful purpose；第二空serve to后接动词原形make。两个并列谓语各自要求不同补足结构。
exp.other: ramp坡道；platform站台；accessible可到达、可使用的。
exp.meaning: 知道serve可译为发挥作用，还要掌握serve a purpose、serve as a noun和serve to do三种实际句型。
exp.rest: explains a purpose是解释一个目的，不是发挥用途，serves as后也不能直接接make；contributes须用to连接目标；accounts for a useful purpose和contributes to a useful purpose没有准确表达本句的设施用途。

q: A new catalogue helped beginners find books. Even among experienced librarians, search times became shorter. What does Even add?
o: It says experienced staff caused the first result.
It cancels the reported benefit for beginners.
It extends the benefit to a less expected group.
It says the second result happened earlier.

exp.trans: 新目录帮助初学者找书；甚至经验丰富的图书馆员也缩短了检索时间。Even把好处推进到较出乎预期的熟练群体。
exp.structure: Even修饰among experienced librarians这一范围短语；search times became shorter是该群体中的陈述，不是前句的原因。
exp.meaning: Even突出递进和意外包含，不取消原命题，也不自动表达因此或时间先后。
exp.rest: caused把递进读成因果；cancels读成否定前文；happened earlier添加时间顺序，均无依据。

q: A museum report says: "Not even replacing every bulb solved the lighting problem." Which statement is supported?
o: Only replacing every bulb solved the problem.
No possible change could ever solve the problem.
The museum never replaced any of its old bulbs.
Replacing every bulb did not solve the problem.

exp.trans: 博物馆报告说：甚至把每个灯泡都换掉，也没有解决照明问题。
exp.structure: Not even将否定和强调作用于replacing every bulb这个本应较有希望的措施；solved的成功结果被否定，不是否定尝试曾发生。
exp.meaning: 此处Even仍突出超出通常预期；not even不等于never tried，也不能把一个措施失败扩大为所有可能措施永远失败。
exp.rest: Only... solved把失败改成唯一成功；No possible change could ever...扩大到一切未来方案；never replaced把措施未奏效误读为根本未实施。

q: The audit highlighted a risk that had existed for years. It did not estimate whether that risk had grown. What does highlighted establish?
o: The audit drew attention to an existing risk.
The risk necessarily became more likely that year.
The audit removed the risk from the workplace.
The risk had already caused severe losses.

exp.trans: 审计指出了一项存在多年的风险，但没有估算它是否上升；highlighted只确认该风险被特别指出。
exp.structure: 主干The audit highlighted a risk；that had existed...是修饰risk的定语从句，不表示audit使风险增大。
exp.meaning: highlight是引人注意或强调；heighten和increase可以表示提高或加剧，不能因拼写相近而混同。
exp.rest: became more likely添加风险上升；removed说风险被消除；severe losses添加已经发生的严重后果，都超出highlighted本身。

q: An exhibition first draws attention to an overlooked problem, then raises visitors' awareness of it. Which pair matches those two actions?
o: heighten the problem; highlight awareness
highlight the problem; heighten awareness
make the problem severe; reduce awareness
increase the problem; hide public awareness

exp.trans: 展览先使一个被忽略的问题受到注意，再提高参观者对它的认识；分别是highlight the problem和heighten awareness。
exp.structure: 两个动作分别以the problem和awareness为宾语；highlight改变注意焦点，heighten表示某种程度提高。
exp.meaning: highlighted与heightened不是同一个词；辨认字形也要检查动作与宾语的语义关系。
exp.rest: heighten the problem不能表达指出问题；make severe或increase the problem会把提高认识改成使问题加重；reduce或hide awareness又与raises方向相反。

q: In a toy forecast, the chance of a parcel being damaged rises from 2% to 5%, while the cost per damaged parcel stays unchanged. Which summary keeps the two dimensions separate?
o: Risk was merely highlighted; its probability stayed fixed.
Damage became more severe; its probability stayed fixed.
Risk increased; the cost of each damaged parcel stayed fixed.
Risk decreased; the cost of each damaged parcel grew.

exp.trans: 示例预测中，包裹受损概率由2%增至5%，但每件受损包裹的损失金额不变：概率提高不等于每次损害更严重。
exp.structure: the chance rises与the cost stays unchanged是对照的两个主谓结构，分别描述发生概率与单位事件损失。
exp.meaning: increased risk表示风险升高，severe描述严重程度；heightened risk也可表达风险加剧，不能仅因与increased近义就判它为错误英语。
exp.rest: merely highlighted把实际概率变化说成只被指出；more severe添加单位损失增加；decreased与2%升至5%相反。

q: A coastal town had fewer storms this year, but each caused more damage than storms in the previous year. Which description preserves both facts?
o: More frequent storms with milder damage.
More frequent storms with unchanged damage.
Less frequent storms with milder damage.
Less frequent storms with more severe damage.

exp.trans: 今年风暴次数较少，但每次造成的损害比去年更大：频率下降，后果更严重。
exp.structure: had fewer storms说明次数；but each caused more damage转向单次后果，不能合并成所有指标都上升或下降。
exp.other: coastal沿海的；frequent频繁的；previous year上一年。
exp.meaning: severe对应后果严重程度，不等于highlighted被强调，也不自动表示次数increased。
exp.rest: More frequent颠倒次数方向；milder把损害加重说成减轻；unchanged遗漏了more damage。

q: A technician sent five of eight sample cards to an outside lab. But three remained in a drawer, where a scanner read their labels. Which summary follows?
o: Three cards stayed in the drawer and were read there.
The three remaining cards gradually decreased in number.
All eight cards were moved back after being scanned.
Only the cards at the outside lab had their labels read.

exp.trans: 八张样本卡中五张送往外部实验室，三张留在抽屉，扫描器在那里读取其标签。
exp.structure: three省略three sample cards，remained in a drawer说明去向；where回指a drawer，引入读取标签的地点。
exp.other: technician技术员；sample card样本卡；label标签。
exp.meaning: 对比的是送走与留存，扫描动作本身不说明留下的卡随后减少；保持位置不自动产生新的数量变化或时间流程。
exp.rest: gradually decreased添加未报告的数量下降；all moved back补造返回步骤；only outside lab排除了原文明示在抽屉中被读取的三张。

q: A club's membership decreased from 70 to 50. Of those 50 members, 20 now attend online; the rest remain at the local venue. Which two claims can both be true?
o: Membership stayed at 70; 20 members moved online.
Membership fell; 30 members still attend in person.
Everyone online left the club; 50 attend in person.
Nobody left the club; 30 members stopped attending.

exp.trans: 会员总数由70降至50；这50人中20人线上参加，其余30人仍在线下场地参加。
exp.structure: decreased描述总量变化；those 50的指代范围是现有50人；the rest为50减20，remain at描述地点保持。
exp.other: membership会员人数；venue场地；in person亲自到场。
exp.meaning: remain与decrease可在同一篇文章描述不同维度，必须分别核对对象和证据，不能机械记成二者绝不同时成立。
exp.rest: stayed at70或Nobody left否定了总量下降；Everyone online left把线上参与误作退会；stopped attending把继续线下参加改成停止参加。

q: An architect emailed a revised plan. The town office replied, "We acknowledge receipt of your plan; the review will begin on Monday." What has the office confirmed?
o: The plan has already passed its review.
The architect has received a purchase slip.
The office has received the revised plan.
The review has been cancelled altogether.

exp.trans: 建筑师发去修订图纸，办公室确认收到，并说明周一才开始审查。
exp.structure: acknowledge的宾语receipt of your plan是名词化结构：your plan是被收到的内容；will begin仍表示后续步骤。
exp.other: architect建筑师；revised修订的；acknowledge确认、承认。
exp.meaning: receipt在这里表示接收事实，不是付款收据；收到材料也不等于完成审查。
exp.rest: passed its review把接收提前升级为审批通过；purchase slip误套购物凭证义；cancelled与周一将开始审查不符。

q: A shop notice says: "Payment is due within ten days of receipt of the goods. Keep the receipt as proof of payment." What do the two uses of receipt mean?
o: Both refer to the date the money was transferred.
First: a sales slip; second: receiving the goods.
Both refer to a paper listing the purchased items.
First: receiving goods; second: proof of payment.

exp.trans: 通知要求收到货物后十天内付款，并保存付款收据。第一处是收到货物，第二处是证明付款的凭证。
exp.structure: receipt of the goods中of引出接收对象；the receipt as proof of payment中receipt是可保存的凭证名词。
exp.other: payment is due应付款；goods货物；proof凭据。
exp.meaning: 不能因为都拼作receipt，就把名词化接收行为与书面凭证当作同一义项。
exp.rest: both date the money was transferred把收货改成收款；sales slip/receiving颠倒两处意思；both paper忽略of the goods中的接收行为。

q: Two coatings faced the same scratch test. One was damaged by light brushing; the other resisted repeated rubbing. The first showed greater susceptibility to scratches. What does this describe?
o: It was more easily affected by scratching.
It was exposed to a greater number of tests.
It had already repaired every scratch itself.
It was guaranteed never to suffer damage.

exp.trans: 两种涂层经受同样的刮擦测试，第一种轻刷即受损，第二种经反复摩擦仍有耐受性；第一种更容易受到刮擦影响。
exp.structure: showed的宾语greater susceptibility，to scratches说明容易受到何种影响；同样测试排除了仅凭接触次数解释词义。
exp.meaning: susceptibility表示易受影响的倾向，不专限医学易感性，也不等于暴露次数或必定发生。
exp.rest: greater number of tests把易受损性改成测试次数；repaired添加自修复；guaranteed never与轻刷受损相反，并加入绝对保证。

q: In a fictional survey, exposure counts the adverts a viewer sees. Susceptibility measures how readily those adverts change a choice. Which finding concerns susceptibility rather than exposure?
o: The viewer saw many adverts during one evening.
One advert readily changed the viewer's choice.
The adverts were shown on several new channels.
The viewer watched for twice as many minutes.

exp.trans: 在一个假设调查中，exposure统计看到多少广告；susceptibility衡量选择多容易受到广告影响。一则广告就容易改变选择，描述的是易受影响程度。
exp.structure: exposure与susceptibility分别作主语，其谓语counts和measures说明两个不同测量对象。
exp.other: fictional虚构、假设的；advert广告；readily容易地。
exp.meaning: 易受影响与接触量可以分开测量，不能把多看广告直接等同于更易受广告影响。
exp.rest: saw many、several channels和twice as many minutes均主要涉及接触数量、途径或时长，没有直接交代选择是否容易被改变。

q: Two writers lived on different continents but exchanged private hopes and fears for years. A biographer praises the intimacy of their letters. What is being praised?
o: The short physical distance between their homes.
The unusually large number of stamps they bought.
The emotional closeness expressed in the letters.
The strict official format used in every letter.

exp.trans: 两位作家相隔不同大陆，却长期交换内心希望和担忧；传记作者称赞书信所表达的情感亲近。
exp.structure: praises的宾语the intimacy of their letters；of短语说明亲近感体现于书信，不要求两人身体接近。
exp.meaning: intimacy可指心灵、关系上的亲近，不能只理解成身体接触。
exp.rest: short physical distance与不同大陆相反；stamps把关系亲密误作邮寄数量；official format把亲近感改成公文形式。

q: Ten listeners sit around a musician, who talks with them between songs. A review praises the intimacy of the setting. Which feature is closest to this meaning?
o: A stage equipped with the latest sound machines.
A large audience kept far away from the performer.
A ceremony governed by strict formal etiquette.
A close atmosphere allowing personal interaction.

exp.trans: 十位听众围坐在音乐家身边，歌曲间隙还相互交谈；评论称赞这种能亲近交流的氛围。
exp.structure: who talks...修饰musician；intimacy of the setting概括小规模、可直接交流的环境特征，而非设备规格。
exp.meaning: intimacy也能描写场所带来的亲近感，不必指恋爱或狭义亲密接触。
exp.rest: latest sound machines讨论设备；large audience far away讨论疏远的大场面；strict formal etiquette讨论礼仪约束，都不对应可直接交流的亲近氛围。
